column1: # Second cohort for the forecast comparison: sampled by kind of line.
# Derived, not chosen — rebuild with tools/build_cohort.py.
# From the timetable of 2026-08-18: every station with >= 20 calls
#   that day and not already polled (4908 of them), split into six
#   cells by busiest-segment traffic (cuts at 41 and 74
#   trains a day) and by whether long-distance services call, then
#   7 sampled per cell with seed 20260824, refusing any pick
#   within 2 segments of one already taken.
# Equal allocation, so this is NOT a representative sample of the
#   network and is never pooled with the first twenty.
